title: fix: pay the Polli CLI quest 1 Pollen, only on accounts 3+ days old
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: The Connect Polli CLI quest now awards 1 Pollen instead of 2. Connected accounts receive the reward only after they are at least 3 days old, using the same account-age check as `early_adopter`; newer accounts can earn it the next time they open quests after day 3. The quest description explains the timing, and rewards already earned remain unchanged.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears a tiny terminal-themed scarf and checks a retro CLI screen beside a three-day calendar and a single lime green (#ecf874) Pollen token, with code-plants growing nearby. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, strictly pixel art, never realistic, with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
